name: Volumetric Unsharp Masking with Multi-scale Hierarchy
aliases: Volumetric Unsharp Masking with Multi-scale Hierarchy — Darkening Shadowed Regions
definition: A feature enhancement technique for volumetric data sets that improves local contrast by lightening salient features and darkening shadowed regions, using a multi-scale volume hierarchy to reduce memory requirements compared to storing two additional full-resolution volumes.
